'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Patrick Johnson DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Patrick Johnson]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Username:''' PMT
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
